# WP02 — OAuth bridge

## Objectives & Success Criteria
- Keep the bridge thin; the event log owns status.

metadata.scenario: SC-003: the event log is the SOLE status authority. Only WP02 plans a state change (label lane:in_progress → Doing, history lane-changed); WP01 (no events) stays untouched; WP03 (canceled, unmapped) stays untouched with lane-state-unmapped reported; the malformed log line is counted in one finding; descriptions never carry status text; a re-run is a no-op.
